note: Contract-driven connection registry (v2.2 C1). Nothing here names a real vendor endpoint, field or auth flow: DNA, MiChat, IMP, Spotlight CMS, MAAP, Project Review and the CRM/opportunity source are owner-unconfirmed (DECISION_LOG D1-D5). Every external connection is not_configured until the owner supplies base URL, auth, schema and sample payloads. Worker secrets are referenced by NAME only; values live in `wrangler secret put`. Enabling a connection is configuration plus a contract test: see docs/CONNECTIONS.md.

retry.policy: jobs.js envelope: max_attempts 5, exponential backoff with equal jitter, base 1s, cap 15 min; 429, 5xx, timeout and network errors retry; 409/412 reconcile; other 4xx fail
retry.honour_retry_after_note: Retry-After is recorded on the attempt result but jobs.js keeps its own backoff schedule

rate_limit.note: TO CONFIRM with the owner; the job pump sends one request per job attempt

data_minimisation.note: never_send_keys: an outbound payload containing any of these keys (at any depth) is refused before a request is built, and a field_mapping that names one as a source is a configuration error. never_to_model_keys: inbound fields that may be shown on screen at most, never placed in model input.

connections.label: Identity (Cloudflare Access / Microsoft Entra)
connections.purpose: Verified sign-in identity of the consultant (and reviewer/admin roles).
connections.status_basis: Implemented and tested with synthetic tokens; never exercised against a real Access or Entra tenant from this repository.

auth.note: Cloudflare Access JWT verification or Entra token validation; see docs/INTEGRATIONS.md

data_minimisation.notes: Identity claims are display and authorisation inputs. The consultant's name is never model input.

connections.label: DNA profile read (prefill)
connections.purpose: Read-only fetch of the signed-in consultant's own profile fields to prefill forms and the interview opening.
connections.required_permission: signed-in subject reading their own profile; DATA_MODE=production for real data
existing_implementation: deploy/cloudflare-edge/src/profile.js (DNA pull with an ASSUMED shape: DNA_PROFILE_URL, DNA_AUTH_HEADER, DNA_FIELD_MAP, secret DNA_API_KEY). Kept as is until the owner confirms the contract; a later task moves it onto this connector.

auth.note: Auth type and header are the owner's to confirm; api_key_header is a placeholder choice reusing the existing secret name.

retry.policy: none (cached read; the profile merge falls back to other sources)

data_minimisation.notes: Only allowlisted fields leave the connector. Names and emails are display-only and never reach a model.

connections.label: Staffing import (CSV)
connections.purpose: Admin or reviewer imports staffing rows (project, consultant, N+1, end date) that drive interview invitations and the N+1 of record.
connections.status_basis: Atlas-defined CSV header, tested locally with the real import code. No external system is called.

auth.note: In-product upload behind Access; `POST /api/triggers` uses secret TRIGGER_SECRET (existing).

data_minimisation.notes: Any other column, including client, customer and account columns, is dropped unread.

connections.label: CRM / IMP opportunity read
connections.purpose: Read-only fetch of an opportunity (role, criteria, location, start date, lifecycle) to prefill context and support bid matching.
connections.required_permission: internal_knowledge use by an authorised signed-in user

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

data_minimisation.notes: Mandatory eligibility is deterministic; preferred fit is evidence-ranked and explained (Integration Contracts §4). Customer identity fields are not allowlisted.

connections.label: DNA skills write-back
connections.purpose: Propose skill assertions backed by an approved evidence revision to the skills master. A story approval is not a skill approval.

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

data_minimisation.notes: Version-aware write; duplicate prevention; conflict response; acknowledgement with destination record id and version (Integration Contracts §1).

connections.label: MiChat CV
connections.purpose: Send approved contribution claims, with reviewed wording only, to the CV destination.
connections.adapter_note: adapter id MECHAT_CV is renamed in M1; the connection id michat_cv is the confirmed name (Tony: MeChat in the pack is a typo for MiChat)

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

may_send: approved contribution claims with reviewed wording
structured outcome and metric fields (no client text)
may_never_send: outcome or metric text (client permission unknown)
data_minimisation.notes: The MiChat contract output is a CV document id, version, generated status, timestamp and validation warnings (Integration Contracts §2).

connections.label: IMP capability signal
connections.purpose: Send a capability signal from approved evidence. Availability and allocation stay IMP's; Atlas never computes them.

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

data_minimisation.notes: IMP availability read (Integration Contracts §3) is not part of this connection and is not built.

connections.label: MAAP Review
connections.purpose: Hand a review's metadata and approved-evidence references to the MAAP system.
connections.required_permission: authorised manager initiation; rubric configured by the process owner
connections.wired_note: No payload builder or job wiring exists: the MAAP rubric is MUST_BE_CONFIGURED_BY_PROCESS_OWNER (D2). Enabling this needs the process owner's methodology and a later build, not only configuration.

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

may_never_send: any inferred emotion, personality, health or attrition signal
automated employment, pay or promotion outcomes
data_minimisation.notes: A MAAP outcome cannot change DNA skill proficiency or employment status.

connections.label: Project Review
connections.purpose: Hand a project review's metadata and approved-evidence references to the Project Review system.
connections.required_permission: authorised start; rubric configured by the process owner
connections.wired_note: No payload builder or job wiring exists: the Project Review rubric is MUST_BE_CONFIGURED_BY_PROCESS_OWNER (D3). Enabling this needs the process owner's methodology and a later build, not only configuration.

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

may_never_send: automated changes to MAAP outcomes, skill levels or employment status
data_minimisation.notes: Project Review does not authorise a Spotlight story.

connections.label: Spotlight CMS
connections.workflow_step_label: Publish approved Spotlight version (public release authorized)
connections.purpose: Submit the exact approved public-safe story revision for publication.
connections.required_permission: every Spotlight gate closed for this revision + public_spotlight grant + named channel

auth.note: Placeholder auth choice; owner to confirm.

may_send: the public audience projection of the approved revision
may_never_send: anything outside the public_story visibility fields
data_minimisation.notes: Only the exact approved revision may publish; the CMS must echo the revision hash and a published state, or Atlas reports the job as failed, never as published.
